def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        id: UUID,
        key: VisitKey,
        stage: VisitStage,
        display_language: DisplayLanguage | None,
        selection: FortuneSelection,
        saju: SajuSnapshot | None,
        pending_card: PendingCard | None,
        request: FortuneRequest | None = None,
        carried_request: CarriedRequest | None,
        undelivered_record_id: UUID | None,
        record_id: UUID | None,
        lease: TurnLease | None,
        last_turn_outcome: TurnOutcome | None,
        version: int,
        persisted_version: int,
    ) -> None:
        self._id: UUID = id
        self._key: VisitKey = key
        self._stage: VisitStage = stage
        self._display_language: DisplayLanguage | None = display_language
        self._selection: FortuneSelection = selection
        self._saju: SajuSnapshot | None = saju
        self._pending_card: PendingCard | None = pending_card
        self._request: FortuneRequest | None = request
        self._carried_request: CarriedRequest | None = carried_request
        self._undelivered_record_id: UUID | None = undelivered_record_id
        self._record_id: UUID | None = record_id
        self._lease: TurnLease | None = lease
        self._last_turn_outcome: TurnOutcome | None = last_turn_outcome

def _to_domain(model: VisitModel) -> Visit:
        stage: VisitStage = VisitStage(model.stage)
        pending_card: PendingCard | None = _read_pending_card(model)
        request: FortuneRequest | None = _read_fortune_request(model.id, model.fortune_request)
        # 손상 처분 확장(§5.1 S2) — 열은 있는데 읽지 못했으면 요청 결합 슬롯도 함께 비운다(§3.2 불변식 «요청 결합 슬롯 ⇒ request»)
        fortune_request_corrupt: bool = model.fortune_request is not None and request is None
        if fortune_request_corrupt and pending_card is not None and pending_card.binds_request():
            pending_card = None
            if stage is VisitStage.SELECTING:
                stage = VisitStage.IDLE
        return Visit(
            id=model.id,
            key=VisitKey(account_id=model.account_id, character_id=model.character_id),
            stage=stage,
            display_language=None if model.display_language is None else DisplayLanguage(code=model.display_language),
            selection=FortuneSelection(
                fortune_id=model.fortune_id,
                selected_character_id=model.selected_character_id,
                prompt_set=_read_prompt_set(model.id, model.prompt_set),
                reservation_id=model.reservation_id,
                displayed_price=model.displayed_price,
                annual_fortune_from_year=model.annual_fortune_from_year,
                annual_fortune_to_year=model.annual_fortune_to_year,
                bundle_id=model.bundle_id,
            ),
            saju=_read_saju_snapshot(model.id, model.saju_snapshot),
            pending_card=pending_card,
            request=request,
            carried_request=_read_carried_request(model.id, model.carried_request),
            undelivered_record_id=model.undelivered_record_id,
            record_id=model.record_id,
            lease=_read_lease(model),
            last_turn_outcome=None if model.last_turn_outcome is None else TurnOutcome(model.last_turn_outcome),
            version=model.version,
            persisted_version=model.version,
        )
